title: No operator surface to mint a workspace binding token for an existing checkout
wanted_capability: An operator-gated, non-interactive way to issue and install a WorkspaceBindingToken for a named existing checkout, so provisional-workspace capture (WorkspaceCaptureClient) and own-visibility MCP sessions can be exercised against an isolated dev daemon. Today production issuance happens only inside DaemonWorkspaceBindingAuthority during managed harness worker spawn; the only direct installation helper is cfg(test). This blocks live validation of any provisional-lane feature (knowledge, gaps, and now project graphs) outside a managed worker, including the reflective-graph live exercise's own-visibility and invalid-provisional legs. Wanted shape: an operator control-plane route or CLI verb that mints a binding for an explicit checkout path under explicit operator authority, mirroring the managed spawn path's stapling; explicitly not agent self-service.
fallback_used: Phase C live exercise reduced to the published leg; provisional behavior covered by integration tests only.
